calculation_notes: Base segment probability: Enterprise 0.85, Strategic 0.9, Mid-market 0.6, Startup 0.35
Health multiplier: health/100 mapped to 0.5-1.2 (cap at 1.2)
Recent engagement multiplier: 1.15 if Last Touch within 30 days else 0.9 if >90 days
Probability buckets for routing: <0.3 = churn-risk (retention play), 0.3-0.6 = at-risk (success + discounts), >0.6 = nurture (upsell + contract optimization)
playbook_fragments: Retention play (churn-risk): immediate exec call, offer 3-6 month concession + targeted success credits, map to CSM escalation path
Recovery play (at-risk): technical remediation, 30-day success plan, propose staggered 6-12 month renewal to reduce friction
Anchor play (high-prop): propose multi-year with volume tiers + performance SLA; include marketing co-sell if strategic
Dedicated conversion: technical sizing workshop -> pilot cluster (4 weeks) -> perf report -> commercial term (90-day POC credit)
Quality remediation: snapshot failing prompts, roll back to previous model variant, create eval suite and automate weekly regression alerts
